title: Stable sorting position
statement: For a function $k: br	o br$ and natural numbers $N$ and $j$, define the position associated to $j$ as the number of indices $i<N$ with $k(i)<k(j)$, plus the number of indices $i<j$ with $k(i)=k(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from natural numbers to natural numbers
caveat: The formal statement uses cntEq, whose definition is not included; the description assumes it counts equal values at indices preceding $j$.
